FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Creative Spectrum Designs, we specialize in providing innovative graphic design services focused on branding and digital content creation for small businesses and non-profit organizations. Our core operations include crafting eye-catching logos, developing marketing materials, and creating visually engaging web graphics, all delivered in a remote working environment. We prioritize the use of licensed software to ensure compliance and protect our intellectual property. Our small team of skilled designers collaborates closely with clients to deliver projects tailored to their specific needs while maintaining robust cybersecurity measures to safeguard client information. We engage subcontractors only when necessary, ensuring they are properly vetted and adequately insured to uphold quality and reliability in all client interactions.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in broadcasting, publishing, or advertising with extensive media production, nor does it rely on non-owned, hired, or rented vehicles for client deliveries or mobile services. Additionally, we are not involved in large-scale event production, installation, or trade show booth construction. The business confirms that it operates with a maximum of 10 employees, including owners and part-time workers, ensuring full compliance with all applicable requirements.
